landscape.label: 2026 Price Guide
title: ADU
Pricing Guide
landscape.say: Thinking about building an ADU in Santa Monica? Here's what it costs in 2026: the price of every type of ADU, what drives the cost, and the permits and fees to plan for.

landscape.label: What's an ADU?
landscape.title: What is an ADU?
landscape.lead: A second, fully independent home on the same lot as your house.
landscape.say: First, what is an ADU? An accessory dwelling unit is a second, fully independent home on your lot, with its own kitchen, bathroom, and entrance. You might know it as a granny flat, guest house, backyard home, or in-law suite.

landscape.label: 2026 Price Ranges
landscape.title: What an ADU costs in Santa Monica
landscape.say: Here are the 2026 planning ranges for a design-build ADU in Santa Monica. A junior ADU runs about $75,000 to $150,000 and up. A garage conversion, $125,000 to $250,000 and up. An attached ADU, $200,000 to $375,000 and up. And a brand-new detached ADU, $250,000 to $500,000 and up.

landscape.label: ADU Type 1 of 4
landscape.name: Junior ADU (JADU)
landscape.desc: A compact unit carved out of existing space inside your home.

bullets.t: Up to 500 sq ft, inside the main house

landscape.say: A junior ADU is carved out of space inside your home, like a bedroom suite or an attached garage, with an efficiency kitchen and bath. It's capped at 500 square feet, and typically runs $75,000 to $150,000 and up, depending on size and scope.

landscape.label: ADU Type 2 of 4
landscape.name: Garage conversion
landscape.desc: Turn an existing garage into a full studio or one-bedroom ADU.

bullets.t: Often the fastest, most affordable path

landscape.say: A garage conversion turns an existing garage into a full studio or one-bedroom ADU. It's often the fastest, most affordable path to a legal rental, because the foundation and structure often already exist. Plan on $125,000 to $250,000 and up, including foundation, utility, and roof upgrades.

landscape.label: ADU Type 3 of 4
landscape.name: Attached ADU
landscape.desc: A new addition connected to your home.

bullets.t: Generally no more than 50% of your home

landscape.say: An attached ADU is a new addition connected to your home, with its own entrance, full kitchen, and bathroom. It can be up to 1,200 square feet, but generally no more than half the size of your existing home. Expect $200,000 to $375,000 and up.

landscape.label: ADU Type 4 of 4
landscape.name: Detached ADU
landscape.desc: A completely new, stand-alone backyard home.

bullets.t: Up to 2 stories or 24 ft tall
850 sq ft for a studio or 1-bedroom

landscape.say: A detached ADU is a completely new, stand-alone backyard home: entirely new construction, one or two stories. Santa Monica allows up to 24 feet tall, 850 square feet for a studio or one-bedroom, and 1,200 square feet for two or more bedrooms. Budget $250,000 to $500,000 and up.

landscape.label: What Drives the Price
landscape.title: What drives your ADU price

cards.name: Size & bedrooms
cards.desc: Bigger costs more overall; smaller costs more per sq ft

cards.name: New build vs. conversion
cards.desc: Reusing a foundation & framing usually costs less

cards.name: Utilities
cards.desc: Sewer, water, gas, electrical & panel upgrades

cards.name: Site access
cards.desc: Narrow side yards & alley access on Westside lots

cards.name: Coastal zone
cards.desc: Coastal permit review adds time & fees near the beach

landscape.say: So what moves your price? Size: bigger units cost more overall, but smaller units cost more per square foot. New build versus conversion: reusing a foundation and framing usually lowers cost. Utilities, like new sewer, water, gas, electrical, and panel upgrades. Site access on narrow Westside lots. Coastal zone review near the beach. And finishes: cabinets, counters, flooring, and fixtures.

landscape.label: Permits & Fees
landscape.title: Permits & fees to plan for

tiles.s: City must act on a complete application

landscape.note: Plan check & permit fees are based on project valuation. Larger units may owe utility & school fees.
landscape.say: Permits and fees affect your budget too. Under state law, ADUs of 750 square feet or less are exempt from impact fees, and Santa Monica exempts ADUs from several of its own. Plan check and permit fees are based on your project's value. The City must act on a complete application within 60 days, and confirm it's complete within 15 business days. And no parking is required.
